a.summary: Wiki-link resolver: renders the resolved / broken / self states for an in-corpus href.

img.summary: Resolves a mount-relative asset off the filesystem.

Callout.summary: An aside block with a kind (note / warning / …).

Lede.summary: The opening paragraph, set apart typographically.

Infobox.summary: The boxed summary panel a wiki entry carries beside its lede.

More.summary: A 'read more' pointer to a related entry.

DocList.summary: A queried list of entries — the generic index primitive.

TagCloud.summary: Every tag in the corpus, weighted by use.

TagList.summary: The tags of one entry, as links to their indexes.

Directory.summary: The entries under one corpus directory.

DirectoryList.summary: A folder listing as a table, with metadata columns chosen by `columns` and narrowed to those the rows actually carry.

Quote.summary: A pull quote with an optional citation.

KeyValue.summary: A definition-list row for infobox-style facts.

Toc.summary: The table of contents derived from the entry's heading anchors.

TableOfContents.summary: The on-this-page heading list, which keeps the active entry in view as the reader scrolls.

PageMeta.summary: The entry's own metadata line (updated, reading time, …).

ChildPages.summary: The entries nested under this one.

Timeline.summary: A dated sequence of entries or events.

FamilyTree.summary: A relationship graph rendered from frontmatter links.

Outlet.summary: The layout chain's inward slot. NOT overridable — the chain's nesting is engine mechanics, and replacing it detaches every layer from the page it wraps.

GroveNav.summary: Top/side navigation. Reads the shell context, so an override must too (or render its own).

shell.summary: The site shell as copyable content. `nav: side` by default; flip the frontmatter to `nav: top` and drop the `<GroveSidebar/>` line for the top-nav arrangement.

section.summary: A folder frame: one shared header above every entry in a subtree, `<ChildPages/>` below. Nest it under a root shell.

hero.arranges: a full-bleed image band over top navigation, then a short grid
hero.summary: A landing root: `nav: top`, a hero band, then `<DocList shape="grid" limit="4"/>`. The picture slot renders the link-graph lattice until `cover:` lands.

feed.summary: A dated list of entries — title, date, lede.

image-excerpt.summary: Cards with a picture slot and an excerpt. The slot holds the link-graph lattice until `cover:` lands (R3-313); it is not gated on it.

timeline.summary: Entries on a dated spine; already matches the reference archetype.

directory.summary: A folder URL with no `index.mdx` of its own — the generated listing. Not a component call: the mechanism is the URL itself.

infinite-scroll.summary: The list that grows as you scroll. Ships with R3-314; declared now because behaviour like this can ONLY be an engine component's literal prop — never a starter file.
